scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @navigator/api & npm run dev -w @navigator/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @navigator/shared && npm run build -w @navigator/api && npm run build -w @navigator/bot && npm run build -w @navigator/worker && npm run build -w @navigator/web
scripts.test: npm run test:content && npm run test:api && npm run test:bot && npm run test:worker
scripts.test:content: npm run build -w @navigator/shared && vitest run tests/content.test.ts
scripts.test:api: npm run build -w @navigator/shared && NODE_ENV=test REMINDERS_STORAGE=memory vitest run tests/api.test.ts
